segments.text: ILP keeps the legal side of your life abroad in order, in six countries, for one monthly fee.
Living abroad comes with legal dates written in another language, and nobody sends you a reminder.
Start with a free two-minute check, and join when you want a lawyer to look at what it found.
Next to a typical fifteen hundred dollar retainer, ILP is seventy-nine dollars and ninety-nine cents a month, with your lawyer calls included.
A late filing can bring a fine, and asking around rarely gives you one clear answer.
Your lawyer reads your file before each call, so your twenty minutes go straight to your question.
Most questions look like these: a residency card coming up for renewal, or a company tax you had never heard of.
Colombia, Costa Rica, Mexico, Panama, Portugal and Spain are all open, each with lawyers licensed there.
Pick your country and take the free check. It takes about two minutes.
